sections.name: Assembled driver, enclosing both AT13 expiry sections

scope: Runtime cross-check of the static D-160 audit. The campaign interval starts at the retained initial Apply clock and ends at trace_end; source audit also covers the initial time read immediately before Apply. The entire assembled driver interval encloses anchor/deadline acquisition through both final AT13 samples. Suite timestamps are receipt times of flushed output. Original admission outputs are captured separately from command streams; the supplied Go shim is unchanged.
